# D3VONN.IO

D3VONN.IO is an AI Business Operating System for supervised agent execution, workflow automation, persistent knowledge, and command-center visibility.

## Core pages

- Homepage: https://d3vonn.io/
- Solutions: https://d3vonn.io/solutions
- Pricing: https://d3vonn.io/pricing
- Security & Trust: https://d3vonn.io/security
- Resources: https://d3vonn.io/resources
- Documentation: https://d3vonn.io/documentation
- Marketplace: https://d3vonn.io/marketplace
- Command Center: https://d3vonn.io/command-center
- Status: https://d3vonn.io/status

## Product summary

D3VONN.IO helps users turn business goals into AI-assisted execution. Hermes acts as the orchestration layer, specialized agents perform work, workflows provide repeatable execution, the knowledge vault stores context, and the Command Center gives visibility into task state, approvals, and operational telemetry.

## Target users

- Founders and operators building AI-powered businesses
- Teams automating repeatable workflows
- Enterprise buyers evaluating governed AI workforce systems
- Developers and partners packaging specialized agents

## Key concepts

- AI Business Operating System
- Hermes orchestration
- Multi-agent workforce
- Supervised autonomy
- Workflow automation
- RAG knowledge vault
- Command-center observability
- Security-first enterprise roadmap
